sections.heading: Gauri Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Gauri Khan was born on 8 October 1970 in New Delhi, and holds Indian nationality. She was given the name گۆری چِبَر at birth and is publicly known as Gauri Khan.
Public records name her father, Colonel Ramesh Chandra Chibber.
She received her education at University of Delhi and Lady Shri Ram College for Women.
